proof.tldrText: API calls are like little door swings at a very busy store: one customer entering is harmless, but autocomplete, filters, page loads, bots, and eager widgets can turn that door into a blur.
proof.detailsText: DetailsIf you want predictable cost, treat every search request as something worth shaping rather than something to discover on the invoice.Debounce ordinary typing.Avoid duplicate page-load searches.Put server-side throttling in front of shared backend traffic.Supporting evidence: Rate limiting API
proof.followupText: Are you protecting against bot traffic, or trying to keep normal browsing costs predictable?
